features.direction: Always retain a unique raw WDL Top1 with explicit probability and protection pair proposal; no odds-based posthoc flips.
features.reference_observation_proxy: ordinary sale confirmed AND Top1 >= 0.50 AND gap to second >= 0.05. This is NOT actual Production authority.
features.recovery_probability_only: ordinary sale confirmed AND 0.42 <= Top1 < 0.50 AND Top1-Top2 >= 0.12 AND no two independent adverse prematch evidence families; potential review ONLY.
features.recovery_evidence_verified: Above and at least two independent precutoff evidence groups, at least one favorable group, none adverse. Never formal grant.
features.core_structural: ordinary sale confirmed AND Top1 >= 0.65 AND Top1-Top2 >= 0.25.
features.core_evidence_review: core_structural AND two independent favorable source groups and zero adverse groups; actual CORE must wait for probability calibration and forward proof.
features.frozen_protection_hardlock: Do not replace a supplied frozen pair; mismatch raises and blocks.
features.direction_conflict: When frozen single disagrees with matrix Top1: hold, never auto-flip.
features.timestamp_contract: Only observed_at <= cutoff < kickoff, explicit timezone. Actual scores strictly post-decision scoring input.

development_replay.oct19_oct20_probability_origin: market/IPF reference only, incomplete full M79 engine
